items.q: but that was a number that Louise Johnson, Freddie Johnson's wife she sang and it was beautiful. I arranged that.

ctx.x: No, he had the singer here, he's an arranger and he helped me arrange that music down in Washington and we come up here to the Apollo Theatre and put it on and in that show, you got to get it and then (humming) I can't ever
think of that name of that song, but that was a number that Louise Johnson, Freddie Johnson's wife she sang and it was beautiful. I arranged that.
Then he had that "Good Night, Angeline," from Jim Europe's band.
